acts.title: The Pyramid
acts.blurb: Two empty thrones, one apprentice who wants them.

acts.title: Open Roads
acts.blurb: Traders, generals and a queen by the river.

acts.title: The Twin Throne
acts.blurb: The old king was never dead.

twists.how: boss seat starts with +N coins (N = param)
conflict pawn starts N steps toward the player's capital

intro.text: The old king is dead. Two thrones stand empty, and the one who builds the greater city wears both crowns.
I am only the apprentice, but I want that crown. Show me you deserve it.
Out-build Pell in a fair duel. No tricks yet: just cards.

outro.text: The first stones are laid. Pell goes pale, but the Quarry master has heard of you.

opponent.name: Pell the Apprentice
opponent.personality: Gentle and careless. Sells cards he should build.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Beginner luck! Next time I will not sell my best cards.
Do not be discouraged. Study what you uncover, and try again.

intro.text: Orrin of the Quarry hoards stone and sells it dear. Your coins will matter.
Reach 40 points: a real city, not a camp.
Orrin owes me a favour. Beat him and I will tell you what I know.

outro.text: Hmph. A builder who counts her coins. Take the stone road to the gate.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Your city is thin. Come back with more trade and more wonders.

intro.text: Warden Brannoc keeps the only gate to the hill. He starts with extra coins.
No city passes my wall. Not yours. Not anyone's.
He builds red and pushes the pawn. Do not let him march.

outro.text: The gate stands open. Beyond it, roads you have never seen. Act two begins.

opponent.name: Warden Brannoc
opponent.personality: Stubborn. Builds red cards and pushes the pawn.
opponent.praise: Well built. The gate is yours.

twist.text: Boss rule: Warden Brannoc starts with 5 extra coins.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Back to your tents. The wall holds.
Walls fall to patience. Try the pawn yourself.

intro.text: Out on the open roads, rivals plan ahead and trade on every corner.
Every card you free is a gift to me. Thank you in advance.
Mind what each card uncovers. Maro always does.

outro.text: You free nothing for free. Impressive. Keep the road.

opponent.name: Maro the Trader
opponent.personality: Hoards coins and denies your best card.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: I ate every card you uncovered. Delicious. Again?

intro.text: General Kest has been marching since dawn. Finish with the conflict pawn on your side.
Ground is held by whoever stands on it.
Shields move the pawn. Count them as carefully as coins.

outro.text: You held the ground. I will remember it.

goal.text: Win with the conflict pawn on your side of the track.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: The ground was mine. Come back stronger.

intro.text: The river city belongs to Queen Seren, and her army is already two steps from your capital.
Kneel, challenger. The Teal Throne has a queen.
Push the pawn back or lose coins to her looting.

outro.text: The throne yields. You have earned the right to ask the final question.

opponent.name: Queen Seren
opponent.personality: Calm and exact. Counts every coin.
opponent.praise: Well dueled. The throne is yours.

twist.text: Boss rule: the conflict pawn starts 2 steps toward your capital.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Your city is not ready for the Teal Throne. Return when it is.

intro.text: Act three. The old rivals return, and now they read the board two moves ahead.
I have learned from you, builder. Stone, wonders, patience.
Take your time. Check every card before you free it.

outro.text: You out-thought a quarry master. The scholars are waiting.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Hard ground, hard lessons. Go again.

intro.text: Sevra the Sage keeps the Long Library. Six different science symbols win outright.
Knowledge is a crown. I am only lending it.
Count her symbols and block the last one.

outro.text: You read the shelves like a book. Now the last army.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: You counted symbols poorly. The Library is patient.

intro.text: General Kest and Sevra stand together: win by the pawn or by science. Points do not count.
Armies and scrolls: you cannot stop both.
Pick one road and run down it.

outro.text: Clean and swift. Only one throne-holder remains.

goal.text: Win by military or science supremacy.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: Steel and scroll together. Not today, builder.

intro.text: King Vael was never dead. He has held both thrones in secret and starts rich.
Two thrones, one king. Kneel before the only crown that matters.
Everything you learned in this war ends here. Build, march and out-think him.

outro.text: Both thrones are yours. The river city and the hill city cheer one name: yours.

twist.text: Boss rule: King Vael starts with 8 extra coins.

easier.text: The rival plays gently and the boss rule is off.

outroLose.text: You were so close. The crowns stay with me.
Rest. Rebuild. The Twin Thrones will still be waiting.

open.text: The old king is dead. Two thrones stand empty, and the greater city wears both crowns.
I am only the apprentice, but I want that crown. Let us see who builds better.
Before any cards: choose the wonders that will mark your city.

close.text: Four wonders each. Now the real work begins: the pyramid of Age I.

open.text: The first age: raw stone, rough roads, and a pyramid of cards between you and Pell.
I will take whatever you uncover. Fair warning.

close.text: You built, bought, sold and raised a wonder. The years begin to turn.
Wait, you can do all that? Show-off.

open.text: Age II. The marks you collected last age now open doors.
Marks? Doors? I just wanted a nice castle.

close.text: Chains, pairs, tokens: a scholar's city. One age remains.

open.text: Age III. The final cards of the war. Everything you own will be counted.
Sixty cards later and I am still not king...

close.text: Count the crown. The tutorial ends, but the story does not.

crowns.title: Ione: your city
crowns.say: Gold banners mark your city, teal marks Pell's. Four wonders will rise in each.

draft.title: Ione: wonders
draft.say: Great works bring points and a power. Claim the glowing wonder before Pell does.
draft.react: Claimed! Pell frowns and eyes the next wonder.

pyramid.title: Ione: the pyramid
pyramid.say: Age I begins. Glowing cards are free to take; cards under others must wait their turn.

take-free.title: Ione: first card
take-free.say: The river is rising. Rock Face costs nothing. Take it.

build-free.title: Ione: build
build-free.say: Build it: stone for your walls, every turn, forever.
build-free.react: Stone for the walls: free, and yours for good.

take-inn.title: Ione: coins
take-inn.say: Pell's tax men eye your purse. Take the Roadside Inn.

build-inn.title: Ione: coin card
build-inn.say: Build it. Yellow cards pay coins at once.
build-inn.react: Four coins in the purse. Gold feeds every plan.

take-red.title: Ione: shields
take-red.say: Pell is gathering troops. The red Lookout carries a shield.

build-red.title: Ione: build red
build-red.say: Build it for 1 coin. A shield pushes the pawn toward Pell.
build-red.react: The pawn marches toward Pell's city!

pawn.title: Ione: the pawn
pawn.say: Nine steps toward a capital wins at once. Marked spaces loot your rival's coins.

take-buy.title: Ione: missing parts
take-buy.say: The Herb Garden needs glass, and you have none. The bank sells it.

build-buy.title: Ione: buying
build-buy.say: Build it. A missing resource costs 2 coins plus what Pell produces.
build-buy.react: Glass bought for coins. And a science symbol: the wheel.

take-chain.title: Ione: chains
take-chain.say: The Remedy Shop gives a science symbol and a chain mark.

build-chain.title: Ione: chain mark
build-chain.say: Build it. Chain marks make matching Age II cards free.
build-chain.react: Chain mark gained: the flask. A later card will cost nothing.

take-sell.title: Ione: unwanted cards
take-sell.say: Some cards do not suit you. Take one anyway to keep it from Pell.

sell.title: Ione: sell
sell.say: Sell it: 2 coins, plus 1 for each yellow card you own.
sell.react: Coins in hand. Now watch what it uncovered.

tension.title: Ione: be careful
tension.say: Pell grabbed the card you uncovered. Always check what a card frees for him.

take-wonder.title: Ione: a wonder
take-wonder.say: A card can raise a wonder instead: points and a power. Take this one.

wonder.title: Ione: raise it
wonder.say: Pick the wonder you can pay for. The card goes under it.
wonder.react: The first wonder rises over your city!

years.title: Ione: Age II
years.say: Seasons turn. Whoever trails on the conflict track picks who starts each age.

take-pair.title: Ione: free by chain
take-pair.say: Herbarium shows the flask mark you own. Take it.

build-pair.title: Ione: chain build
build-pair.say: Build it free. Its wheel matches the one in your city.
build-pair.react: A second wheel: a pair! Choose your reward.

token.title: Ione: progress token
token.say: A pair earns a progress token: a bonus you keep all game. Choose one.
token.react: A token for the whole game. Pell scowls.

sci.title: Ione: science win
sci.say: Six different science symbols win the game on the spot. Keep counting yours.

take-chain2.title: Ione: another chain
take-chain2.say: Star Gazers opens with your leaf mark. Take it.

build-chain2.title: Ione: new symbol
build-chain2.say: Build it free. A new symbol: one step toward six.
build-chain2.react: A third symbol. Six different would end it all.

age3.title: Ione: Age III
age3.say: The last age. Guild cards score from the richer city. Pell has left one for you.

take-guild.title: Ione: the guild
take-guild.say: The Builders' Lodge rewards wonders. Take it.

build-guild.title: Ione: guild build
build-guild.say: Build it. Guilds score at the very end.
build-guild.react: The Lodge is yours. Now count everything.

scoring.title: Ione: the count
scoring.say: Civic, science, trade, guilds, wonders, tokens, coins and conflict: every point is counted.

verdict.title: Ione: the verdict
verdict.say: Most points wins. A tie goes to the most civic (blue) points.

pell.freed: Pell: You uncovered that for me? Thank you!

end.title: The first crown is claimed
end.text: You drafted, built, bought, sold, raised wonders, chained, paired and counted. Time for a real duel.

intro: Two thrones stand empty. Draft your wonders, then out-build the rival.
The river city and the hill city both claim the crown. Prove yours is greater.
One pyramid, two rulers. Take smart, and leave the rival nothing.
